verdict.text: NO. Out of sample (Oct 2020 - Nov 2026), after 0.10% fees, the continuously learning 15m agent (c) does not beat buy-and-hold and momentum on a risk-adjusted basis across seeds: seed-mean Sharpe -0.37 (seeds above buy-and-hold's 0.64: 0 of 3; above momentum's 0.63: 0 of 3), Calmar -0.15 vs 0.29 and 0.34, net return -53% vs buy-and-hold +249%. Its break-even fee is -0.174% (loses before fees) a side. None of the 9 agent variants or filters beats both on every seed.
